verdict.rationale: Supabase exposes a documented Management API (supabase-docs-28) and REST/GraphQL APIs auto-generated from the database schema (supabase-docs-27, supabase-docs-42), backed by a live OpenAPI spec confirmed via probe (supabase-probe-3). Combined with the CLI (supabase-docs-5/32) and official MCP server (supabase-docs-1, supabase-probe-4) for AI-driven interaction, this gives AI-native users a fully documented, programmatic public API surface. Missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration specifically of API completeness/stability beyond vendor docs.
